visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Sort and Compare Instead of Deleting Letters
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Each letter of the first word is searched in a StringBuilder copy of the second word and deleted from it. Sort both char arrays and compare them with Arrays.equals. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: The old approach is a search and a delete for every letter. Sorting both words makes anagrams identical, so the whole check is one comparison, and it says what an anagram is.
